tessa: Kicked off Sapling Medical POC perf baseline this morning. Sharing quick observations and run plan.
omar: Thanks — what's their SLA goal again?
tessa: They want 99p < 350ms at sustained 700 qps, peaks to 3k qps. We're running baseline (fp16) vs q4 and q8 quant variants.
felix: any numbers from the smoke?
tessa: 15m steady at 700 qps, seq=64: med baseline 62ms, q4 54ms, q8 50ms. p95 baseline 140ms, q4 155ms, q8 165ms. p99 baseline 300ms, q4 had spikes up to 850ms (rare), q8 had a tail at ~420ms.
omar: Spike pattern? correlated with prefix churn or AZ routing?
tessa: Spikes line up with prefix churn windows and occasional GPU memcpy stall signs. We saw higher page-fault counters on quant kernels during bursts.
felix: Please paste the exact bench command used.
tessa: Run command: ```
./bench --model redwood-xl-v2 --variant q4_0 --seq 64 --qps 700 --concurrency 10 --prefetch async --ramp 480 --prefix-skew 0.4
```
ria: infra note: ded pool slot candidate "ded-usw-12g" available 2026-06-20 03:00-06:00 UTC.
legal-bot: Reminder: Sapling requested customer-managed KMS + CloudHSM. Send compliance contact for BAA.
omar: For stability we should test: 1) long steady-state 3x45m at target qps with 50% unique prefixes; 2) short peak storms 3k qps for 60s; 3) AZ failover mid-run. Collect nvlink, memcpy stalls, kernel eviction, and cgroups.
felix: Also add GPU mem high-water and page-fault histograms. We'll try a KV-pin config on next run.
tessa: Observed that enabling prefetch async reduced p95 but didn't fix rare p99 q4 spikes. KV-pin hypothesized to reduce tail.
ria: Booked ded slot: ded-usw-12g, 2026-06-20 03:00-06:00 UTC.
omar: Procurement asked for a ballpark uplift for reserved 3k qps peak with 15% headroom (1yr commitment). Need a figure by COB.
felix: Rough estimate: reserved peak add-on w/ SLA & multi-AZ ~ $30k/mo. PAYG equivalent ~ $52k/mo. If quant path becomes stable we can offer estimated token-cost saving ~12% on their model mix.
tessa: Security Q: Sapling wants HSM-backed signing and KMS in their account. Any blockers for PHI on Dedicated?
legal-bot: Dedicated + Private supports customer KMS and CloudHSM. We'll initiate BAA; no known PHI blockers. Confirm external HSM vendor compatibility if they have a specific appliance.
felix: Ops plan: run KV-pin candidate patch on one canary node and keep fallback route to baseline model for 7% of traffic. If p99 tail reduces below 350ms we can scale canary.
omar: Good. Also prepare a simple A/B cost sheet showing token cost delta baseline vs q4 vs q8 at their expected mix + reserved uplift.
tessa: Action items:
- felix/omar: execute 3x45m steady runs + 3x30s peak storms during ded-usw-12g slot with KV-pin on canary (target run: 2026-06-20 window)
- ria: collect nvlink/gpu memcpy, kernel eviction logs, cgroup OOM, and upload to perf share
- tessa: send procurement ballpark and ask for planned go-live month by EOD
- legal-bot: start BAA thread and confirm CloudHSM vendor checklist
- felix: open runtime PR for KV-pin + link to canary config

tessa: If we can prove 99p < 350ms at 700 qps on Dedicated with fallbacks, sales will push a 12mo committed deal. Let's keep the tests lean and collect good traces. :muscle:
ria: slot confirmed: ded-usw-12g, 2026-06-20 03:00-06:00 UTC.
